findings.note: Bill text says it was introduced by Martin R. Zamora. HB 157, School Teachers On-Site Protection Act, would have the Department of Public Safety train school employees, license and appoint them to carry handguns on school premises, and add them to the exceptions to the ban on carrying a deadly weapon on school premises. Final status not checked.
